name: Eternal Dreamscape
source:
"Living in a dream should be a happy reality, but what if something you thought that was in your head was keeping you inside?"

[From [url=https://waifumaker.itch.io/eternal-dreamscape]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“生活在梦里，本该是幸福的现实。可如果有个你以为只存在于脑海中的东西，将你困在了里面呢？”

[摘自[url=https://waifumaker.itch.io/eternal-dreamscape]itch.io[/url]]
